title: Why Bulbasaur Is More Than Starter Number One

scenes.headline: Bulbasaur was built different
scenes.narration: Bulbasaur wasn't just the first starter. In the original Pokédex, it was literally number one.
scenes.caption: The first entry in the original Pokédex.

scenes.headline: Entry number one
scenes.narration: Its National Pokédex number is zero zero one, making every Pokédex journey begin with Bulbasaur.
scenes.caption: Every National Pokédex begins at #001.

scenes.headline: Two types from the start
scenes.narration: Unlike most early starters, Bulbasaur begins as both Grass and Poison type from level one.
scenes.caption: Grass + Poison before its first evolution.

scenes.headline: Partner, not passenger
scenes.narration: The seed on its back is planted at birth. It grows by absorbing sunlight as Bulbasaur grows.
scenes.caption: Its seed grows with it by absorbing sunlight.

scenes.headline: Control the battle
scenes.narration: Vine Whip brings reach, while status moves like Sleep Powder turn Bulbasaur into a clever battlefield controller.
scenes.caption: Vines, powders, healing, and battlefield control.

scenes.headline: Seed to full bloom
scenes.narration: At level sixteen it evolves into Ivysaur, then at level thirty-two into Venusaur.
scenes.caption: Bulbasaur → Ivysaur → Venusaur

scenes.headline: Who should be next?
scenes.narration: That's Bulbasaur in one pulse. Which Pokémon should we unlock next?
scenes.caption: Follow @PokePulses • Comment the next number
